_metadata.description: Web UI dashboard (5-surface): Overview, Exposure (lease management), Recovery & Events, Metrics, and Audit, on the vrooli-default design kit.

requirements.title: Render the five operator dashboard surfaces
requirements.description: The dashboard provides five navigable surfaces — Overview, Exposure, Recovery & Events, Metrics, and Audit — each rendering live backend state.

requirements.title: Manage leases from the Exposure surface
requirements.description: The Exposure surface lists routes with tier and lease state and lets the operator request, extend, and revoke leases, reflecting the resulting state.

requirements.title: Display color-coded health on the Overview surface
requirements.description: The Overview surface shows tunnel and per-route health with green/yellow/red color coding for quick at-a-glance status, using accessible roles and WCAG AA contrast.

requirements.title: Show metrics, recovery events, and audit findings on their surfaces
requirements.description: The Metrics surface charts cloudflared time-series, Recovery & Events lists recovery attempts/outcomes, and Audit lists port-compliance findings, each from live API data.
